english.title: Driver of a vehicle fail to stop / provide own / owner details after an injury / damage accident on Heathrow Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a part of Heathrow Airport to which the road traffic enactments did not apply, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), when an accident involving the vehicle occurred by which

(A)_[personal injury was caused to a person other than the driver of the vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..),]_
(B)_[damage was caused to a vehicle other than that vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(C)_[damage was caused to an animal other than an animal in or on that vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ANIMAL..),]_
(D)_[damage was caused to property constructed on, fixed to, growing in or otherwise forming part of the land on which the road in question was situated or land adjacent to such land, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NATURE OF THE DAMAGE..),]_

you failed to stop, give your name and address, the name and address of the owner of the vehicle, the registration number or identity marks of the vehicle and details of the accident to a constable through the published airport emergency telephone number as soon as reasonably practicable
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 10.2 and 2.3 of the Heathrow Airport - London Byelaws, 2014 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
